jobs.title: Enterprise Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ENTERPRISE GROWTH LEAD




IN BRIEF

 - We’re a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

 - We are looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Growth Lead to lead revenue growth in a territory. In this role, you will develop and execute a sales and account growth strategy to drive adoption of our solutions across health systems. You’ll be at the forefront of our mission, working closely with hospital executives and clinical leaders to bring our groundbreaking technology to life.


WHO WE ARE

We’re using state-of-the-art tech to build AI co-pilots for doctors and nurses to literally help them save lives! Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. https://www.bayesianhealth.com/sepsis-research/?__hstc=251652889.1e7598f5de0ed9b513da684474e8a044.1710861879595.1710945070565.1710971833587.3&__hssc=251652889.1.1710971833587&__hsfp=1890770568

We’re a diverse and experienced team of AI/ML experts, software engineers, product designers, behavior change specialists, and clinicians. We’re not afraid of hard problems and are highly results-oriented. We also like to have fun while we’re working on hard things. Our culture is highly collaborative, inclusive, supportive, and we have a strict “no jerks” policy.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Proven Commercial Leadership: 7+ years of sales and account management experience with a strong track record in healthcare and/or SaaS sales, specifically within hospital systems and early stage, innovative concepts to C-suite buyers. Healthcare consulting and financial services success will also be considered.

 - Exceptional Communication and Negotiation Skills: Ability to effectively communicate the value proposition and challenge diverse stakeholders in order to win complex, high-stakes deals.

 - Data-Driven Decision Making: Skilled in sales analytics, and pipeline forecasting

 - Team Leadership Experience: Proven experience in leading, coaching, and motivating teams to achieve ambitious targets.

 - Adaptability: Thrive in a start-up environment with a strong ability to pivot and adapt as the company scales.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Sales Strategy and Execution: Develop and implement a strategic sales and account growth plan for the region to exceed revenue goals and drive long-term growth.

 - Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with C-level executives, key stakeholders, and decision-makers within hospital systems.

 - Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team; provide guidance on complex negotiations, consultative selling, and professional growth.

 - Market Insights: Stay current with industry trends, market conditions, and competitor offerings to refine the go-to-market approach and position our technology effectively.

 - Collaborative Execution: Partner with Leadership, Product / Tech and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment on messaging, product feedback, and post-sale support.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or related field; MBA, MHA or MD / DO is a plus.

 - Experience with hospital-specific technology solutions, including those with EMR integration

 - Network of contacts within hospital systems and healthcare networks.

jobs.title: Client Success Account Executive, Clinical
jobs.description:
Client Success Account Executive, Clinical

In Brief

 - We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

 - Lead clinical health system accounts through strategic implementation and lifecycle management, utilizing data to drive adoption, optimize outcomes, and unlock expansion opportunities across clinical modules.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.



We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. https://www.bayesianhealth.com/sepsis-research/?__hstc=251652889.1e7598f5de0ed9b513da684474e8a044.1710861879595.1710945070565.1710971833587.3&__hssc=251652889.1.1710971833587&__hsfp=1890770568



What You'll Do

As a Client Success Account Executive, Clinical, you become the strategic face of Bayesian for health system clients, guiding them from implementation through their entire lifecycle. You'll cultivate executive relationships, design stakeholder engagement strategies, and lead cross-functional teams to drive product adoption and clinical outcomes. Your clinical expertise allows you to communicate the value of clinical decision tools while utilizing data to demonstrate impact, optimize workflows, and identify expansion opportunities. You'll gain buy-in from nursing and physician stakeholders, support clinical research evaluation, and contribute to our product roadmap through voice of customer insights. This role requires executive presence, clinical credibility, and a passion for improving healthcare delivery.

Responsibilities

 - Strategic Account Leadership: Serve as primary point of contact throughout implementation and beyond, cultivating relationships with key clinical and executive stakeholders while designing strategic engagement frameworks.

 - Process Development: Develop repeatable success processes, contribute to product roadmap via voice of the customer, and scale team capabilities as the business grows.

 - Data-Driven Optimization: Utilize clinical and operational data to drive decision-making, demonstrate value, reduce time to treatment, and improve patient outcomes across your client portfolio.

 - Adoption & Expansion: Lead cross-functional teams to drive platform adoption among nursing and physician users, building narratives around clinical value that unlock natural expansion into new modules.

Minimum Qualifications

 - 5+ years experience in Client Success, Account Management, or Consulting managing high-priority customers with proven track record of driving renewals and expansion.

 - Clinical background as a nurse, therapist, or advanced practitioner with ability to communicate value of clinical decision tools in driving outcomes.

 - Executive presence with ability to lead and influence executive and frontline teams across varying backgrounds.

 - Results-oriented approach with a track record of exceeding expectations and continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

 - 3+ years proven ability to drive measurable value and unlock expansion opportunities with health system clients.

 - Experience working with health system executives and utilizing tech platforms to drive clinical and operational value.

 - Demonstrated problem-solving through clinical research or improvement projects.

 - Ability to understand, interpret, and communicate clinical research findings to diverse audiences.
